ma.reason_fresh_only: Correct terminal mode requires complete fresh trajectories; do not silently reenable legacy replay with nonterminal bootstrapping.

optimizer_handoff: Identical common MA64 critics and their ValueNorm128; fresh Adam. Only Solver Actor and its KL reference differ.
stop_interpretation: Eight-hour hard wall budget with last-hour report reserve; keep the last validated state and invalidate MA superiority if a phase budget is incomplete.

budget.accounting: Consumed H+W trajectories, including critic warmup; not matched FLOPs/tokens.
budget.generation: One-round prefetch and incomplete episodes are separately recorded, not free.
budget.inherited_accounting: Unique known upstream consumed rows: common MA64 critic lineage1024; W1 arm additionally inherits640. Not total research cost or token/FLOP equivalence; H0 pretraining not independently auditable.

selection.matched: Prespecified final round only; selection48 and unchanged incumbent guard.
selection.best: Not an endpoint; do not run.
selection.harness: Retain frozen initial H0 patch unless a new patch gains at least2/48 on selection48 mean@1.
selection.report: Freeze selection before a fresh single sample on the same all200/strict197.
selection.initial: Fresh fixed H0 and empty baseline; W1 additionally unchanged h2; no initial-score-based adaptation.

initialization_scope: w1 Solver Actor; common H0 Engineer and MA64 critics; fresh Adam
